searchText: Reminder: PeerDAS breakout in ~7min Agenda:https://github.com/ethereum/pm/issues/1193 Zoom: https://ethereumfoundation.zoom.us/j/87225793361?pwd=Pe0H4sFMX9wr1HFRLfQo3yrDB6a4hk.1 <@539495253418180618> <@656728086410297356> I am turning 180 degrees on this, and Pari will surely provide a lot of context on ACD, but I think the devnets show that whatever is currently broken on mainnet, it will continue being equally broken and it won't get worse with a blob target increase. It seems that increasing the target and not the limit will be actually a non-trivial change in our codebase though. So if we do go with an increase, I want to leave the suggestion that we go with an increase to 4/8 rather than 4/6. It solves the pricing issue, the code complexity around having these changes and changing our Merklke proof of inclusion, etc.. and is more likely to land in time for the fork. We can do another run of tests on scenarios closer to mainnet later on, but I think at least in what long-range tests we are seing, the increase in the target/limit is doable. yeah, thats a good point that 4/8 would simplify some immediate-term things i wanted to discuss this EIP thursday that proposes going to 6/9, https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-7691 maybe 4/8 is a nice middle ground all things considered 6 for target is a completely different game, we aren't testing nearly close to that 🙂 but we could Would love to see 6/9 or maybe 5/10 (if we want to keep target / max ratio), want to emphasize that we've reached blob saturation already and there are quite a lot of usages that can be unlocked by blob number increase, let's discuss in the call 🙏 <dankrad> Agree. Target increase is much more important for users than limit increase

excerpts.author: potuz
excerpts.content: <@539495253418180618> <@656728086410297356> I am turning 180 degrees on this, and Pari will surely provide a lot of context on ACD, but I think the devnets show that whatever is currently broken on mainnet, it will continue being equally broken and it won't get worse with a blob target increase. It seems that increasing the target and not the limit will be actually a non-trivial change in our codebase though. So if we do go with an increase, I want to leave the suggestion that we go with an increase to 4/8 rather than 4/6. It solves the pricing issue, the code complexity around having these changes and changing our Merklke proof of inclusion, etc.. and is more likely to land in time for the fork. We can do another run of tests on scenarios closer to mainnet later on, but I think at least in what long-range tests we are seing, the increase in the target/limit is doable.

excerpts.author: ralexstokes
excerpts.content:
yeah, thats a good point that 4/8 would simplify some immediate-term things

i wanted to discuss this EIP thursday that proposes going to 6/9, https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-7691

maybe 4/8 is a nice middle ground all things considered

excerpts.author: potuz
excerpts.content: 6 for target is a completely different game, we aren't testing nearly close to that 🙂

excerpts.content: Would love to see 6/9 or maybe 5/10 (if we want to keep target / max ratio), want to emphasize that we've reached blob saturation already and there are quite a lot of usages that can be unlocked by blob number increase, let's discuss in the call 🙏
